messages:
alice: Heads-up — planning a coordinated unpin of runtime v2.15 and SDK v3.0 during the Monday merge window. want to outline rollback and monitoring before we lift the pin.

mike: +1. which clusters are in the initial canary?

alice: canary: eu-west-1a and us-west-2b, 10% traffic each. we’ll route fallback to runtime v2.14 if anything odd.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Current pinlist shows runtime v2.14 pinned for 'llama3-q' family. SDK 2.x is still default for hosted. See /pinlist at https://deploy.redwood/pins :information_source: 

ben: Quick compatibility note — SDK v3.0 drops the old `batch_hint` param; we remapped server-side but double-checking clients. If any internal clients still send it, runtime will ignore but log warnings.

carla: QA will run the new regression set against canaries at +15m and +60m. I’ll post results in here.

alice: rollback trigger criteria: 1) >2% 5m error-rate increase for gen endpoints; 2) median latency regression >40ms for p95; 3) any severe correctness regression flagged by evals. If triggered, we pin back to runtime v2.14 and rollback SDK to 2.9.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. I’ll prepare an automated rollback job `rollback/runtime-to-2.14` that can be kicked via deploy-bot. Also will enable extra alerts for the canaries.

mike: How do we trigger the rollback from the Slack thread? can deploy-bot accept `@deploy-bot rollback runtime 2.14 --reason "canary regression"`?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: yes, that command is supported in this channel. Example: `@deploy-bot rollback runtime --version 2.14 --scope canary --note "canary regression"`. It will open a rollback PR and start the orchestration after approval.

carla: QA smoke checklist (short):
```
- pod start/success within 60s
- tokenized output shape checks
- sample prompts baseline fuzz check
- end-to-end latency < configured SLO
```
I’ll attach run ids after execution.

ben: Request: add a compatibility note in the release notes about `batch_hint` -> `batch_mode` mapping and SDK deprecation timeline. ops needs to be aware for customer communication.

alice: Good call. @mike can you draft the blurb for release notes and include rollback contact info and exact pin commands?

mike: will do. Draft: "SDK v3.0 introduces new client semantics for batching (batch_mode). Runtime v2.15 supports both but will log deprecations. If customers rely on old semantics, see migration guide. For emergency rollback, contact SRE oncall or run `@deploy-bot rollback runtime --version 2.14`." Thoughts?

carla: fine. please add expected downtime (none for canary; full traffic switch may take up to 2 min during rollback).

mike: updated.

alice: final checklist before unpin:
- docs/rel-notes updated (mike)
- canary jobs scheduled (carla)
- rollback job ready (sre-oncall)
- deploy-bot pinlist updated to allow unpin for runtime family (ben)

ben: I’ll update the pinlist rule to allow runtime v2.15 unpin for the two canary clusters at 09:00 UTC Monday. Then we can lift for canary and evaluate.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Canary job scheduled: job/rel-v3-canary-20260320 id=job-8421. Will post artifacts to /artifacts/job-8421.

alice: timing: 09:00 UTC — lift canary pin, monitor for 60 minutes, then decision to promote or revert at ~10:15 UTC.

sre-oncall: I’ll be watching metrics and ready to trigger rollback. tagging incident channel #incidents as well.

carla: smoke run started when canary lifts? I’ll kick at +5m automatically via pipeline.

mike: release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/723 — ping for review.

alice: thanks everyone. if no blockers, proceed with the schedule. post canary status here. :rocket:

(automated) deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinlist update applied for canary clusters. Unpin allowed window starts 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z.
